studyQueue.title: The AI Iceberg Index: Sector & Role Exposure Across North America
studyQueue.question: How much of the wage economy is exposed to AI beneath the visible tech surface (MIT / Oak Ridge Project Iceberg: 2.2% visible vs. 11.7% submerged), how do occupational roles break down inside the 12 major NAICS industries, and how does exposure shift across regional economies?
studyQueue.dataset: MIT / ORNL Project Iceberg (151M workers, 923 occupations, 32k skills) + BLS OES / StatCan NAICS sector matrices
studyQueue.notes: First end-to-end Workbench test study: interactive regional map, 12-industry x 6-role matrix, and compiled LaTeX PDF.

studyQueue.title: 2026 Alberta Referendum: All 10 Ballot Questions & Demographic Vote Anatomy
studyQueue.question: Why did Alberta voters pass all 5 non-constitutional immigration/voter-ID questions, reject all 4 constitutional amendments, and vote 74.95% to 25.05% to remain in Canada — and how did age, region, party coalition, and identity attachment divide the vote?
studyQueue.dataset: Elections Alberta Oct 19, 2026 count (>2.07M ballots) + Abacus Data (n=1,021) + Research Co. exit & pre-vote polls (n=811, n=601)
studyQueue.notes: Second Workbench study: compares ballot categories, regional/age/party splits, and voter motives with a compiled LaTeX PDF.

studyQueue.title: First to Four Basketball — Leverage & Run-Distribution Study
studyQueue.question: Which challenge wins carry the highest conditional series-clinch swing, and how do streak lengths compare with a stationary coin-flip baseline?
studyQueue.dataset: records/basketball/series.json (13 series, 73 rounds) + upcoming Series 14+ logs
studyQueue.notes: Queued for the JimmyHighRoller-style deep dive once the next series batch is logged.

studyQueue.title: Primer-Style Evolutionary & Market Agent Simulations
studyQueue.question: How do replicator dynamics and spatial resource limits shift cooperative vs. hawkish equilibria in small populations?
studyQueue.dataset: Synthetic agent trajectories + phase_lab simulation runner
studyQueue.notes: Planned interactive simulation branch with downloadable parameter seeds.

studyQueue.title: Sodium Battery Technology
studyQueue.question: How does sodium-ion battery chemistry compare to lithium-ion at the elemental and electrochemical level, why do those differences arise from the periodic table, and how will grid-scale sodium batteries be deployed to prevent massive blackout power events once manufactured at scale?
studyQueue.dataset: ANL BatPaC v5.1 (2025) + NREL ATB Utility-Scale BESS + USGS Mineral Commodity Summaries (2025-2026) + IEA Global EV & Battery Outlook
studyQueue.notes: Added from mobile Workbench queue and promoted to canonical Electrochemistry dashboard + Tectonic PDF.

studyQueue.title: Gas Price Collusion
studyQueue.question: Study which countries have gas prices that are much higher than cost, and see if companies are few and colluding to keep prices high. Go over Game Theory incentives as to why certain industries would do this and others wouldn't.
studyQueue.dataset: IEA Energy Prices & Taxes + Germany MTS-K (Assad et al. 2024 JPE) + WA FuelWatch (Byrne & de Roos 2019 AER) + UK CMA (2023-2025) + NRCan / CNE
studyQueue.notes: Published via Gemini 4 Argon + Pandas: interactive 12-country pump price decomposition, Rockets & Feathers ECM, repeated Bertrand supergame inspector, and compiled LaTeX PDF.

studyQueue.title: Calorie Intake & Deficit vs. Weightlifting Strength Rate-of-Change
studyQueue.question: Do my lifting numbers, top-set Epley 1RM, 10+/12+ rep-target progression, and session-over-session rate of strength increase (d(Volume)/dt and d(1RM)/dt) go up or down based on same-day and lagged 7-day moving-average calorie intake, protein grams, and net caloric deficit on my own site?
studyQueue.notes: Queued cross-section study using internal site athletics + calorie tracking logs once additional training weeks accumulate.

theoryQueue.title: Electrochemical Potentials, Nernstian Equilibria & Alkali Intercalation From First Principles
theoryQueue.scopePrompt: Introduce Electrochemistry from scratch: Gibbs free energy, chemical potentials, the Nernst equation, Butler-Volmer overpotentials, and Period 2 vs. Period 3 alkali intercalation.
theoryQueue.notes: Integrated into Mental Map § 1.3.3 and the Electrochemistry destination.

theoryQueue.title: Non-Cooperative Game Theory, Nash Equilibria & Infinitely Repeated Oligopoly Supergames
theoryQueue.scopePrompt: Introduce Game Theory from scratch: strategic-form games, Bertrand vs. Cournot competition, folk theorems, grim-trigger SPNE thresholds, and monitoring lags.
theoryQueue.notes: Integrated into Mental Map § 2.2.4 and the Game Theory destination.

theoryQueue.title: Replicator Dynamics, Evolutionary Stability & Spatial Resource Games
theoryQueue.scopePrompt: Derive the replicator differential equation from discrete generational payoffs and connect ESS conditions to spatial agent simulations.
theoryQueue.notes: Pairs with ST-04 Primer-style simulation study.

applicationsQueue.title: Grid-Scale Sodium-Ion BESS Architecture for Polar-Vortex Blackout Prevention
applicationsQueue.systemDesign: 4-to-12 hour utility substation battery banks using Polyanionic NFPP / Prussian White cells with dual Al collectors and 0 V safe maintenance.
applicationsQueue.societalBenefit: Prevents catastrophic winter heating blackouts at −20°C to −35°C without lithium or copper supply bottlenecks.
applicationsQueue.notes: Live in Electrochemistry (ST-05) and Mental Map § 1.3.3.

applicationsQueue.title: Consumer Fuel-Price Portals vs. Algorithmic Collusion Guardrails
applicationsQueue.systemDesign: Design asymmetric disclosure rules (delayed bulk API feeds + maverick club station licensing) that help consumers search without giving oligopolists 0-second retaliation feeds.
applicationsQueue.societalBenefit: Compresses 25–28 c/L oligopoly fuel markups toward the 12 c/L competitive benchmark, saving households billions annually.
applicationsQueue.notes: Live in Game Theory (ST-06) and Mental Map § 2.2.4.

applicationsQueue.title: Autoregulated Progressive Overload Under a Caloric Deficit
applicationsQueue.systemDesign: Combine daily TDEE/consumption logs with 10+ and 12+ rep-target thresholds to time deloads and carbohydrate refeeds.
applicationsQueue.societalBenefit: Preserves lean muscle mass and central nervous system recovery during sustained fat-loss phases.
applicationsQueue.notes: Pairs with ST-07 Calorie vs. Lifting progression study.

Two percent above the water, ninety-eight in the dark,
They only count the lightning when the server catches a spark.
Every ledger in the tower got a ghost in the sheet,
I'm running tempo up the Escarpment just to measure the beat.

rapLyrics.title: Cold Air, High NEAT
rapLyrics.bars:
Sixteen thousand steps before the sun clears the frost,
Count the deficit in chalk dust, never count what it cost.
Plate loaded to the collar, twelve reps on the bar,
Keep the notebook in the gym bag where the blueprints are.

rapLyrics.title: Ballot Box / Fault Line
rapLyrics.bars:
Ten questions on the paper, three-to-one on the stay,
Half the room wants a megaphone, half wants a way.
Draw the border in the oil sand, draw it in the poll,
Everybody wants the leverage till you tally the toll.

schemaSql:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS study_queue (
    id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    created_on TEXT NOT NULL,
    title TEXT NOT NULL,
    atlas_path TEXT NOT NULL,
    question TEXT NOT NULL,
    dataset TEXT NOT NULL,
    status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (status IN ('published', 'in-progress', 'queued')),
    study_route TEXT,
    paper_route TEXT,
    clicks INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    notes TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT ''
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS theory_queue (
    id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    created_on TEXT NOT NULL,
    category TEXT NOT NULL,
    title TEXT NOT NULL,
    atlas_path TEXT NOT NULL,
    scope_prompt TEXT NOT NULL,
    status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (status IN ('published', 'in-progress', 'queued')),
    notes TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT ''
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS applications_queue (
    id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    created_on TEXT NOT NULL,
    domain TEXT NOT NULL,
    title TEXT NOT NULL,
    atlas_path TEXT NOT NULL,
    system_design TEXT NOT NULL,
    societal_benefit TEXT NOT NULL,
    status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (status IN ('published', 'in-progress', 'queued')),
    notes TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT ''
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS wishlist_todos (
    id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    created_on TEXT NOT NULL,
    title TEXT NOT NULL,
    category TEXT NOT NULL,
    priority TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (priority IN ('high', 'medium', 'low')),
    atlas_path TEXT NOT NULL,
    status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (status IN ('done', 'in-progress', 'planned')),
    notes TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT ''
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS rap_lyrics (
    id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    created_on TEXT NOT NULL,
    bucket TEXT NOT NULL,
    title TEXT NOT NULL,
    bars TEXT NOT NULL,
    theme_cue TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (status IN ('draft', 'recorded', 'published'))
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS voice_notes (
    id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    created_on TEXT NOT NULL,
    channel TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (channel IN ('Journal', 'Podcast', 'Study Memo', 'Freestyle')),
    title TEXT NOT NULL,
    duration_seconds INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (duration_seconds >= 0),
    audio_format TEXT NOT NULL,
    transcript TEXT NOT NULL,
    summary TEXT NOT NULL,
    atlas_path TEXT NOT NULL,
    status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (status IN ('processed', 'queued'))
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS site_traffic (
    ip_index TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    masked_ip TEXT NOT NULL,
    role TEXT NOT NULL,
    visits INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
    study_clicks INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    top_section TEXT NOT NULL,
    last_seen TEXT NOT NULL
);
